_comment: Manual voter-registration-by-party snapshots for states whose official source can't be auto-fetched from CI (bot protection on the site/files, or figures only in a JS page or press release). Read by hand from the official page and refreshed periodically; registration_update.py merges these for states NOT covered by an auto parser in SOURCES (a real parser always wins). Refresh all of these in late October 2026.

id.note: Manual snapshot summed from the VoteIdaho county table (Cloudflare/JS; not auto-fetchable). Constitution+Libertarian -> oth, Unaffiliated -> npa. Refresh late Oct 2026.

az.note: Manual snapshot of the 'Voter Registration Statistics - July 2026 (Primary)' table on the AZ SoS page (azsos.gov and apps.azsos.gov block automated requests). Total 4,306,554. 'Other' (voters not in a recognized party, mostly party-not-designated) -> npa; Libertarian 30,415 + No Labels 46,246 + Green 5,312 -> oth. Refresh late Oct 2026 (the October/general report).

ma.note: Manual snapshot of the Secretary of the Commonwealth's newest enrollment breakdown published as a web page (as of 02/01/2025; total 5,025,826). Unenrolled -> npa; political designations -> oth. sec.state.ma.us blocks automated requests. A September 2026 state-primary workbook exists on the Election Data Hub (download only). Refresh late Oct 2026 when the state-election enrollment breakdown is posted.

nv.note: Manual snapshot of ACTIVE registered voters from the NV SoS monthly release (Sept 2, 2026; total 2,062,136). Nonpartisan -> npa; Independent American 82,903 + Libertarian 13,620 + other minor 30,806 -> oth. nvsos.gov blocks automated requests (Incapsula). Refresh monthly/late Oct 2026.

nh.note: Manual snapshot from the NH SoS 'Party Registration History 1970-2026' table (total 862,162). Undeclared -> npa. sos.nh.gov blocks automated requests. Refresh late Oct 2026.
